title: Keto Italian Antipasto Board
seo_title: Keto Antipasto Board: Italian Charcuterie Without Bread
description: A keto Italian antipasto board for 8: fresh mozzarella, provolone, Parmesan, prosciutto, Genoa salami, soppressata, olives, peppers and pesto. About 5 g net carbs.
hook: Antipasto without the bread basket: almost everything on an Italian antipasto platter is already low-carb.
why: Italian antipasto is naturally close to keto: three cheeses (fresh mozzarella, provolone and Parmesan chunks) and three cured meats, plus olives, roasted peppers and pepperoncini from jars.

The only thing missing is the bread, and cucumber rounds with pesto and fresh basil fill that spot. Two kinds of olives and the pepperoncini give every rich bite a briny, tangy reset. About 5 g net carbs per serving.

timeline.what: Take out the provolone and Parmigiano.
Drain the mozzarella; slice the cucumber.
Build the board; drizzle pesto over the mozzarella.

faq.a: Mostly. Cheese, cured meats, olives, roasted peppers, artichokes and pepperoncini are all low in carbs. Skip the bread and breadsticks.
About 5 g net carbs per serving for 8.

faq.q: What can I use instead of bread?
faq.a: Cucumber rounds, endive leaves or parmesan crisps.
